portedInvariants: stock lot identity is warehouse plus GRN plus package
balance equals inbound minus writeoff
reserve never changes physical balance
writeoff cannot consume reserved or missing balance
writeoff return cannot exceed prior writeoff
physical storage addresses use rack shelf number and optional slot code

an empty place and an old address are legal lot places: old data and the manual correction keep them as is, leading zeros of a rack code are dropped, regular entry, moves and receiving still need a rack code, and a whole-location move never takes them
whole-location moves preserve slots and skip zero-balance lots
article is the primary stock identity while name is an optional description
manufacturer series is distinct from the internal GRN
legacy names migrate into article without changing stock accounting
repeated receipts fill a missing article and update a supplied manufacturer series
search and fulfillment selection use article-first warehouse identity
warehouse list stitches repeated lots by article and can group them by type shelf name or series
unnamed legacy lots remain independently expandable by GRN so their article can be repaired
manual stock requires an article and keeps article and manufacturer series as strings
manual stock suggests name series and type from existing lots terminal and coax references connector families and coax article codes
article-derived suggestions only fill blank fields and remain editable
single-lot identity edits require the optimistic version so a stale article correction is rejected

a lot keeps its passport: the mass of one piece from the largest filled 1/10/100-piece sample rounded to 5 decimals, expiry, manufacturer, description, storage conditions, datasheet and certificate; a repeated receipt replaces the expiry and only a real mass
